privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At GoalX, we respect the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy explains in general terms what information may be collected when using the site, how it may be used, and what third-party technologies may be involved during navigation.

collection.title: Information that may be collected
collection.p1: GoalX may process technical information generated during the use of the site, such as IP address, browser type, device, operating system, pages visited, date and time of access, and other technical data related to navigation.
collection.p2: GoalX does not directly request financial information, bank passwords, or credit card data to use the public features of the site.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.p1: GoalX and certain external providers may use cookies, identifiers, web beacons, or other similar technologies to operate the site, measure its performance, and display advertising.
cookies.p2: Users can configure their browser to block or delete cookies. However, some site features or certain third-party services could be affected.

ads.title: Google AdSense and advertising
ads.p1: GoalX uses Google AdSense to display ads. Google and other third-party vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to GoalX or other websites.
ads.p2: The use of advertising cookies enables Google and its partners to serve ads that may be related to the user's interests and previous internet activity.
ads.p3: Users may manage or opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings.

consent.title: Consent and privacy management
consent.p1: When required by applicable law, GoalX may display a consent message managed through a Google-certified consent management platform.
consent.p2: Such mechanism allows the user to accept, reject, or manage certain purposes related to cookies and advertising, depending on their location and applicable regulations.

thirdParty.title: Third-party vendors
thirdParty.p1: Some ads may be served by Google or authorized advertising networks and vendors. These third parties may use their own measurement, advertising, or device identification technologies in accordance with their respective policies.
thirdParty.p2: The processing carried out directly by third parties is subject to their own policies and conditions.

purpose.title: Purpose of information
purpose.subtitle: The technical information collected may be used to:
list: operate and maintain the functioning of the site;
analyze the performance and usage of GoalX;

externalLinks.title: Links to external sites
externalLinks.p1: GoalX may contain links to external sites. GoalX does not control the privacy policies, content, or practices of those sites. It is recommended to review their respective policies before providing information.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: This Privacy Policy may be updated when GoalX's features, the providers used, or applicable legal obligations change. The update date will be shown at the top of the document.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: If you have any questions related to this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at:

privacyPolicy.footerNote: GoalX is an informational platform for sports analysis, statistics, and predictions. The information presented does not constitute financial advice nor does it guarantee future results.
